panels.title: Board
panels.description: online / offline, posted by the broker (the ESP32's last will)

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: -30d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "board_status" and r._field == "value")
  |> last()
  |> keep(columns: ["_value"])

panels.title: Last data
panels.description: When the last message from the board arrived

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: -30d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "board" and r._field == "ms")
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: int(v: r._time) / 1000000}))

panels.title: Parts made
panels.description: All four machines, in the time range (top right)

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "board" and r._field =~ /^cnt_[0-3]$/)
  |> difference(nonNegative: true)
  |> sum()
  |> group()
  |> sum()

panels.title: Good
panels.description: QC Good presses in the time range

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "board" and r._field =~ /^good$/)
  |> difference(nonNegative: true)
  |> sum()
  |> group()
  |> sum()

panels.title: Reject
panels.description: QC Reject presses in the time range

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "board" and r._field =~ /^rej$/)
  |> difference(nonNegative: true)
  |> sum()
  |> group()
  |> sum()

panels.title: Quality (yield)
panels.description: Good / (Good + Reject) in the time range: the Q of OEE

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "board" and (r._field == "good" or r._field == "rej"))
  |> difference(nonNegative: true)
  |> sum()
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_measurement"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_value: if exists r.good and exists r.rej and r.good + r.rej > 0.0 then r.good / (r.good + r.rej) else 0.0}))

panels.title: Machine state
panels.description: Running = run switch on, no alarm and speed above 0 % (the same rule as the website and the sheet). Grey = no data from the board.

targets.query:
state = (run, pot, al) => if al == 1.0 then 2.0 else if run == 1.0 and pot >= 13.0 then 1.0 else 0.0
pot = (v) => if exists v then v else 1023.0
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "board" and (r._field =~ /^(run|pot)_[0-3]$/ or r._field == "al"))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: true)
  |> group(columns: ["line"])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, M1: if not exists r.al then -1.0 else state(run: r.run_0, pot: pot(v: r.pot_0), al: r.al), M2: if not exists r.al then -1.0 else state(run: r.run_1, pot: pot(v: r.pot_1), al: r.al), M3: if not exists r.al then -1.0 else state(run: r.run_2, pot: pot(v: r.pot_2), al: r.al), M4: if not exists r.al then -1.0 else state(run: r.run_3, pot: pot(v: r.pot_3), al: r.al)}))

panels.title: Run ratio (A)
panels.description: Share of the logged time each machine was running: the A of OEE, against the time the board was on

targets.query:
state = (run, pot, al) => if al == 1.0 then 2.0 else if run == 1.0 and pot >= 13.0 then 1.0 else 0.0
pot = (v) => if exists v then v else 1023.0
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "board" and (r._field =~ /^(run|pot)_[0-3]$/ or r._field == "al"))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> group(columns: ["line"])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.al)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, M1: state(run: r.run_0, pot: pot(v: r.pot_0), al: r.al), M2: state(run: r.run_1, pot: pot(v: r.pot_1), al: r.al), M3: state(run: r.run_2, pot: pot(v: r.pot_2), al: r.al), M4: state(run: r.run_3, pot: pot(v: r.pot_3), al: r.al)}))
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, M1: if r.M1 == 1.0 then 1.0 else 0.0, M2: if r.M2 == 1.0 then 1.0 else 0.0, M3: if r.M3 == 1.0 then 1.0 else 0.0, M4: if r.M4 == 1.0 then 1.0 else 0.0}))
  |> reduce(identity: {n: 0.0, M1: 0.0, M2: 0.0, M3: 0.0, M4: 0.0}, fn: (r, accumulator) => ({n: accumulator.n + 1.0, M1: accumulator.M1 + r.M1, M2: accumulator.M2 + r.M2, M3: accumulator.M3 + r.M3, M4: accumulator.M4 + r.M4}))
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({M1: r.M1 / r.n, M2: r.M2 / r.n, M3: r.M3 / r.n, M4: r.M4 / r.n}))

panels.title: Parts per interval
panels.description: Parts each machine finished in each bar's time slot

targets.query:
name = (f) => if f =~ /_0$/ then "M1" else if f =~ /_1$/ then "M2" else if f =~ /_2$/ then "M3" else "M4"
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "board" and r._field =~ /^cnt_[0-3]$/)
  |> difference(nonNegative: true)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: sum, createEmpty: true)
  |> fill(value: 0.0)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _field: name(f: r._field), _value: r._value}))
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")

panels.title: Speed setting (knobs)
panels.description: Speed knob of each machine, 0-200 % (100 % = knob in the middle)

targets.query:
name = (f) => if f =~ /_0$/ then "M1" else if f =~ /_1$/ then "M2" else if f =~ /_2$/ then "M3" else "M4"
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "board" and r._field =~ /^pot_[0-3]$/)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _field: name(f: r._field), _value: float(v: int(v: r._value / 1023.0 * 40.0 + 0.5)) * 5.0}))
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
